sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish
relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: First Solar (NASDAQ:FSLR) Raised to Buy at HSBC

Analysts currently hold a "Moderate Buy" consensus for First Solar with an average price target of $254.89.

feed.summary: Inter & Co reported record second-quarter 2026 earnings, achieving a "Rule of 50" milestone with 32% net revenue growth and 16.3% return on equity. Operational metrics highlight strong customer engagement and platform scale, with 26.4 million active clients and substantial daily transaction volumes.

feed.title: S&P 500 Hits Record Highs — But BofA Warns Bullish Sentiment Has Gone Too Far
feed.summary: Bank of America's proprietary Bull & Bear Indicator has reached its most extreme bullish reading since 2021, prompting the bank to warn investors that market optimism is at dangerous levels. Strategists recommend rotating away from high-beta sectors like tech and banks towards defensive assets, cash, and short-duration holdings. This warning comes as the S&P 500 hits record highs and massive liquidity pours into financial markets, with significant inflows into equity and fixed income funds.

feed.title: CVS outlook revised to positive by Moody’s on turnaround
feed.summary: Moody's Ratings has revised CVS Health Corporation's outlook from stable to positive, affirming its Baa3 senior unsecured notes and other ratings. This upgrade reflects significant progress in CVS's health insurance business turnaround, including membership adjustments and pricing modifications, which have led to declining financial leverage. While CVS benefits from its strong market position and rising prescription drug use, it still faces challenges in its health insurance operation and regulatory uncertainty in its PBM business.

feed.title: Tranche Update on Republic Services, Inc.'s Equity Buyback Plan announced on October 26, 2023.
feed.summary: Republic Services, Inc. repurchased 1,729,256 shares for $358.7 million between April 1, 2026, and June 30, 2026. This brings the total repurchased shares to 9,396,015, valued at $1,994.9 million, under the buyback plan announced on October 26, 2023. The repurchases represent 3.02% of the company's equity.

feed.title: American Tower (NYSE:AMT) Leans On Data Centers As Tower Demand Stays Firm
feed.summary: American Tower (NYSE:AMT) is strategically leveraging its CoreSite data center business to complement its steady wireless tower operations. The company is experiencing record leasing activity and double-digit expansion in its data centers, driven by increasing demand from cloud, hybrid multi-cloud, and artificial intelligence customers. This growth positions American Tower at the intersection of mobile networks and AI computing, ensuring continued demand for both its tower and data center assets.

feed.title: Pepsi’s Next Grocery Bet Isn’t on Chips or Soda. It’s on Cold Soup at Whole Foods
feed.summary: PepsiCo is expanding its Alvalle brand into the U.S. market with the launch of its Mediterranean-style gazpacho at select Whole Foods stores. This move marks PepsiCo's entry into the cold soup category, targeting consumers looking for convenient, fresh, and meal-adjacent products. The company chose Whole Foods as its exclusive launch partner to build credibility before wider expansion.

feed.title: New era for Clearwater UK as KeyCorp deal completes
feed.summary: Clearwater UK has officially completed its acquisition by KeyCorp, marking a new era for the corporate finance advisory firm. This deal enhances M&A and Debt Advisory services for clients, strengthening cross-border expertise while maintaining a commitment to the UK's mid-market and regional presence through its four offices. The existing UK leadership team remains unchanged, and the firm continues its focus on developing internal talent.

feed.title: Travelers Insurance New Mexico UIM coverage class action settlement
feed.summary: Travelers Insurance has reached a class action settlement concerning claims that it misled New Mexico policyholders about underinsured motorist (UIM) coverage. The settlement benefits policyholders who had UIM coverage with Travelers between January 1, 2015, and August 16, 2022. Eligible class members can receive either a premium refund of 29% of UIM premiums paid or a re-evaluation of their UIM claims without the previously applied offset.

feed.title: Key moves at Celebrity/Royal in hotel ops, revenue, commercial
feed.summary: Celebrity Cruises and Royal Caribbean International have announced several key leadership promotions and expanded responsibilities. Michael Goldner was appointed SVP hotel operations for Celebrity, Brian Rosenthal now leads revenue management at Royal Caribbean International, and Kevin Rice takes over Celebrity's revenue management. Additionally, Michael Scheiner was promoted to SVP commercial at Celebrity, and Kara Wallace's remit at Royal Caribbean was expanded to include contact centers.

feed.title: Howmet Aerospace Sets Execution Standard With Beat-and-Raise, RBC Says

Howmet Aerospace reported impressive Q2 2026 earnings and revenue growth, prompting an increase in its 2026 guidance, driven by rising jet production and demand for aerospace parts. UBS and Deutsche Bank also adjusted their price targets for Howmet Aerospace after the positive results.

feed.title: Deere (DE) Stock May Be A Bargain Despite Contract Extension Standoff
feed.summary: Deere (DE) has seen a 70.3% return over five years and trades at US$614.84, appearing undervalued based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model and its P/E ratio, despite mixed broader valuation checks. feed.title: Oncor weighs impact of Texas data center freeze on nearly 300-GW load pipeline
feed.summary: Oncor, a subsidiary of Sempra, is assessing the implications of a state-wide freeze on new data center interconnection approvals in Texas, which has impacted its nearly 300 GW load pipeline. Executives support Governor Greg Abbott's decision, citing the need for durable long-term outcomes and the alignment of load growth with generation construction. Despite the uncertainty, Oncor's CEO expressed confidence in continued strong growth, with service requests increasing to 298 GW.

feed.title: Network security platform and AI governance at Fortinet
feed.summary: Fortinet is addressing the complexities of the AI era by advocating for a unified network security platform that integrates networking and security into a single, consistently governed fabric. This strategy, dubbed the "SASE Firewall," converges secure access service edge and next-generation firewall capabilities. The company is also developing AI governance tools to monitor and control internal AI infrastructure usage, ensuring sanctioned use and preventing data exfiltration.

feed.title: Elon Musk Wants Starlink To Take On T-Mobile, Verizon, AT&T—Here's Why That's Easier Said Than Done
feed.summary: SpaceX's Starlink Mobile aims to launch service by late 2027, intending to compete with major carriers like AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile. While recent FCC approvals and a planned increase in next-generation satellites boost Starlink's capabilities, analysts remain skeptical about its ability to compete directly with established ground networks, especially in dense urban areas. Starlink plans to address terrestrial coverage with small cellular base stations rather than traditional towers, a strategy that analysts believe will be challenging and require significant capital.

feed.title: Republic Services reports increased Q2 revenue
feed.summary: Republic Services Inc. announced strong second-quarter financial results, reporting a net income of $566 million and a 4.6 percent increase in total revenue. The company has updated its full-year financial guidance, increasing projected revenue to $17.2 billion to $17.3 billion, citing disciplined cost management and strategic execution. Republic Services also completed two renewable natural gas projects and invested significantly in acquisitions and shareholder returns.

feed.title: Microsoft Is Winning the AI Cash Flow Test
feed.summary: Microsoft is distinguishing itself among hyperscale companies by maintaining positive free cash flow despite significant investments in AI infrastructure, unlike competitors like Alphabet and Amazon which have seen their free cash flow turn negative. While Microsoft is also spending heavily on AI, its strong Azure growth is enabling it to absorb these investments effectively. This positions Microsoft as a benchmark for investors who are increasingly scrutinizing the financial returns of AI spending.

feed.title: Narrow-Moat Steris' Recurring Revenue and Margin Improvement Create Opportunistic Outlook
feed.summary: Steris, a narrow-moat company, is a leading provider of sterilization products and services in healthcare. Recent acquisitions have expanded its portfolio, positioning it as a "one-stop shop" for outpatient settings. The company's focus on recurring revenue and margin improvements suggests an opportunistic outlook, further supported by healthy fundamentals allowing for accelerated repurchases and investment.

feed.title: FedEx St. Jude Championship Director says despite changes, Memphis still on rise as golf city
feed.summary: The FedEx St. Jude Championship will no longer be a premier "Championship Series" event after 2027 due to PGA Tour format changes, which include splitting the schedule into a "Championship Series" and a "Challenger Series." Despite this, Executive Director Robert Miller states that Memphis is still growing as a golf city and will maximize any future tournaments it hosts. FedEx's title sponsorship contract also expires in 2027, with no mention of them in the new Tour format announcement.

feed.title: Chicago’s quantum explosion: Infleqtion opens new West Loop quantum innovation center
feed.summary: Infleqtion, a Colorado-based quantum computing company, has opened a new 7,500 square-foot innovation center in Chicago's West Loop, expanding its presence in the city's growing quantum sector. The company plans to deploy its fault-tolerant, neutral-atom quantum computer at the Illinois Quantum & Microelectronics Park by 2027, with a focus on practical applications for the American energy grid. This expansion is supported by Illinois state tax credits and aligns with efforts to move quantum computing into commercial use while creating jobs.

feed.title: Bad Timing or Bad Luck? Shelley Moore Capito Sold Apple and Coca‑Cola Before Big Moves
feed.summary: Senator Shelley Moore Capito (R-W.Va.) and her spouse sold shares of Apple, Coca-Cola, and Microsoft before these stocks experienced significant price increases or reached new all-time highs, leading to questions about their trading timing. While the senator has been selling more stocks than buying in recent years, her and her husband have consistently bought Meta Platforms stock, indicating a potential long-term preference for that "Magnificent Seven" company. This activity highlights the ongoing scrutiny of congressional stock trades and their implications.

feed.title: Deadline Alert: Pentair plc (PNR) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
feed.summary: Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP is urging shareholders of Pentair plc (PNR) who suffered losses to contact them regarding a securities fraud lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Pentair failed to disclose significant inventory destocking in the Pool channel, which negatively impacted sales and operating income, causing the stock price to fall. Investors who purchased securities between April 28, 2026, and July 14, 2026, have until October 2, 2026, to file a lead plaintiff motion.

feed.title: Republic Services reports increased Q2 revenue

Republic Services has also updated its full-year financial guidance, projecting revenue between $17.2 billion and $17.3 billion.

feed.title: Biogen, Investors Reach Settlement Outline Over Alzheimer’s Drug
feed.summary: Biogen has reached a preliminary settlement agreement with investors who filed a class-action lawsuit alleging the company misrepresented clinical trial data for its Alzheimer's drug, Aduhelm. The terms of the settlement, including the financial amount, are not yet public but are expected to be filed within 60 days. The lawsuit claimed Biogen withheld data indicating patients treated with a higher dose of Aduhelm showed less favorable results.

feed.title: Wells Fargo & Company Raises Expedia Group (NASDAQ:EXPE) Price Target to $307.00
feed.summary: Wells Fargo & Company has raised its price target for Expedia Group (NASDAQ:EXPE) to $307.00 from $303.00, while maintaining an "equal weight" rating. This adjustment comes after Expedia exceeded quarterly expectations with adjusted earnings of $5.76 per share and a 14% year-over-year revenue increase to $4.32 billion, leading management to raise its 2026 revenue outlook. Despite a "Hold" consensus among analysts, positives cited include stronger domestic travel, cost discipline, AI investments, and B2B growth, though some analysts suggest limited near-term upside due to softness in parts of Europe.

feed.title: Xcel Energy considers another rate increase as some Colorado regulators question methodology
feed.summary: Xcel Energy is proposing another rate increase for its customers in Colorado, but state regulators are scrutinizing the company's method for determining affordability. Xcel uses "share of wallet" to suggest its rates are low, stating Coloradans spend less than 1% of their income on electricity, a claim challenged by the Public Utilities Commission due to Colorado's high median income. Xcel maintains that by various metrics, Coloradans pay some of the lowest utility rates in the nation.

feed.title: BNP Paribas Adjusts CF Industries Price Target to $120 From $130
feed.summary: BNP Paribas has adjusted its price target for CF Industries Holdings, Inc. (CF) to $120, down from the previous target of $130. This adjustment comes amidst other analyst revisions, with Goldman Sachs increasing its target to $123 and UBS maintaining a neutral rating with a target of $123. CF Industries recently reported its Q2 2026 earnings, with revenues and EPS below FactSet estimates.

feed.title: Susquehanna Adjusts Expedia Group Price Target to $315 From $250
feed.summary: Susquehanna has increased its price target for Expedia Group (EXPE) to $315 from $250. This adjustment reflects a positive outlook for the online travel agency, which specializes in cultural and leisure activity information, tourist travel sales, and online hotel price comparisons. Several other analysts have also recently adjusted their price targets for Expedia, generally upwards.

feed.title: First Solar Diversifies The Source Of Your Risk, Not Its Size
feed.summary: First Solar (FSLR) offers a unique investment profile, acting as a "return engine" rather than a shock absorber due to its low correlation to the S&P 500 but high volatility. While it diversifies risk sources, it doesn't reduce overall portfolio volatility, as it captures more of the market's losses than its gains. The article highlights its operational independence, driven by factors like Section 232 actions and plant operations, rather than broader market trends.

feed.title: Analog Devices Inc Stock (ADI) Moved Up by 3.26% on Aug 7: A Full Analysis
feed.summary: Analog Devices Inc (ADI) stock rose by 3.26% on August 7, outperforming the Technology Equipment sector. This increase is attributed to the recovery in the high-performance analog semiconductor market, driven by stabilizing demand in industrial automation and automotive electrification. Analysts maintain a consensus Buy rating with an average price target of $453.28, despite some company-specific risks like severe industrial segment contraction and communications sector weakness.

feed.title: Qualcomm Inc Stock (QCOM) Moved Up by 3.30% on Aug 7: Facts Behind the Movement
feed.summary: Qualcomm Inc (QCOM) stock rose by 3.30% on August 7, driven by stronger-than-expected fiscal third-quarter earnings, significant growth in the smartphone and AI hardware markets, and successful diversification into the automotive and PC sectors. Analyst upgrades and positive macroeconomic factors also contributed to the positive movement. Despite neutral technical indicators, the company's strategic positioning in AI and edge computing, coupled with high licensing margins, has boosted investor confidence, though risks like ongoing litigation with Arm Holdings and customer concentration remain.

feed.title: Tyson Foods board declares quarterly dividend
feed.summary: The board of directors of Tyson Foods Inc. has declared a quarterly dividend payment of 51 cents per share for Class A shareholders, payable on December 15. The annual dividend rate is $2.04 per share, yielding 3.42%. Class B shares, exclusively held by the Tyson Family, will receive approximately 46 cents per share and maintain a 10-to-1 voting ratio.

feed.title: How Iridium’s SKYWAVE IoT Partnership Could Reshape Remote Connectivity For Iridium Communications (IRDM) Investors
feed.summary: Iridium Communications Inc. partnered with SKYWAVE to integrate Iridium's satellite network with SKYWAVE's IoT platform, aiming to enhance remote connectivity for heavy equipment manufacturers and other industrial sectors. This collaboration strengthens Iridium's IoT investment narrative by embedding its Short Burst Data into multi-network industrial platforms, alongside the recent launch of its PNT ASIC. While promising for broadening Iridium's services in industrial markets, investors should consider potential risks like uneven PNT adoption and slower IoT growth impacting revenue forecasts.

feed.title: ConocoPhillips Anticipates Limited Delays for Qatar’s North Field East LNG Project
feed.summary: ConocoPhillips expects only limited delays for the North Field East (NFE) LNG project in Qatar, despite recent geopolitical tensions and supply chain issues. This comes as BP takes full ownership of the Calypso natural gas project offshore Trinidad and Tobago, further solidifying its position in the region. The article also touches on other developments in the global LNG market, including the expansion of infrastructure and the impact of geopolitical events on natural gas prices.

feed.title: Innovex International (NYSE:INVX) Shares Gap Down - Here's What Happened
feed.summary: Innovex International (NYSE: INVX) shares gapped down by 6.8% to $28.45, despite the company beating its quarterly earnings and revenue estimates. Analyst sentiment is mixed, with an average rating of "Moderate Buy" and a target price of $32.25, but several firms have recently downgraded the stock. An insider also sold 10,750 shares worth approximately $301,000.

feed.title: Satya Nadella Said Microsoft's Own AI Chips Are Driving Up to 40% Efficiency Gains. Here's Why That Matters for Investors
feed.summary: Microsoft's CEO, Satya Nadella, revealed that running its MAI models on custom AI chips leads to 40% better performance per watt, resulting in lower operating costs and potentially higher margins for its cloud segment. This efficiency gain, coupled with a growing cloud backlog and expanding AI infrastructure spending, positions Microsoft for continued revenue and earnings growth. While the stock has lagged broader equities this year, there is ample upside remaining for investors.

feed.title: Uviquity Gains Coherent’s Ex-CEO To Build Quantum Photonics
feed.summary: Uviquity has appointed Dr. Vincent D. (“Chuck”) Mattera, Jr., former Chair and CEO of Coherent Corp., as a Strategic Advisor to advance its aluminum nitride (AlN) photonics platform. Mattera will help Uviquity scale its integrated photonic circuits for quantum systems, advanced sensing, and deep ultraviolet applications. The company aims to commercialize deep-UV laser modules by Q4 2026, leveraging Mattera's experience in transforming foundational technologies into global businesses.

feed.title: Coherent Corp. (NYSE:COHR) jumps 41% over the week as China optics restrictions coincide with earnings report
feed.summary: Coherent Corp. (NYSE:COHR) saw its stock jump 41% over the past week, driven by a proposed U.S. restriction on Chinese optical transceiver imports and strong investor anticipation ahead of its August 12 earnings report. This policy shift is viewed as "directionally bullish" for Coherent, as Chinese suppliers currently hold a significant market share. The company's equity value has climbed by approximately $21 billion since July 31, reflecting expectations of increased market share and strong fiscal Q4 results, particularly in its AI optics-driven Datacenter and Communications segment.
